stem.text: The potential difference across a metal wire is kept constant. The length $l$ and the diameter $d$ of the wire are both varied. The type of metal is kept the same.
How is the current in the wire related to $l$ and $d$?

A.text: It is directly proportional to $l$ and inversely proportional to $d$.

B.text: It is directly proportional to $l$ and inversely proportional to $d^{2}$.

C.text: It is inversely proportional to $l$ and directly proportional to $d$.

D.text: It is inversely proportional to $l$ and directly proportional to $d^{2}$.
